title: envelope.adopt_step_answered
description: WS-433 / FIND-305 — fired by `cwos-adopt-install.js step-gate --emit` when a founder answers a /adopt Step 4b-* prompt. The next step's `step-gate --requires` refuses to render until the prior step's event exists, enforcing the single-question 4b ordering that prose alone failed to hold (DEC-029 / feedback_airtight_via_hooks). One step per event — a batched multi-step emit is rejected.
